question: In which of the following years did Jahangir die?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1627.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nur-ud-Din Muhammad Salim,** often known as Jahangir, was the** fourth Mughal Emperor, **reigning from 1605 until his death in 1627
 
• "G**olden chain of justice"** which is for the people suffering from the injustices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Mughal Empire was an Islamic early-modern empire that ruled over most of South Asia.
 
• **Sultan Babur created the Mughal kingdom **in the sixteenth century, following his epic victory over the **Lodhi Sultan in 1526.**
